## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-juan late-Míng / early-Qīng Cáodòng-line Chán lamp record by Yǒngjué Yuánxián, supplementing the existing *Wǔdēng huìyuán* ([KR6q0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0011)) and *Xù chuándēng lù* ([KR6q0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0015)) traditions with expanded coverage of the Cáodòng line through the Yuán and Míng. Title — "Continuing-Lamp Record" — frames it as continuation rather than revision.

**Abstract**

Yuánxián was one of the two most important seventeenth-century Cáodòng-line masters (alongside [無異元來](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A1%E7%95%B0%E5%85%83%E4%BE%86) Wúyì Yuánlái, 1575–1630), and his *Jìdēng lù* is the principal Cáodòng-side late-Míng contribution to the lamp-record literature, distinct from and in a certain counterpoint to the contemporary Línjì-line works by [費隱通容](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B2%BB%E9%9A%B1%E9%80%9A%E5%AE%B9) Fèiyǐn Tōngróng. Unlike Tōngróng's polemical *Wǔdēng yántǒng* ([KR6q0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0018)), Yuánxián's compilation is restrained and scholarly; it restores the Cáodòng-line attributions while avoiding direct polemic against the Línjì.
